envelope.description: Verify Vibe session settings before dispatch

body.title: Verify Vibe session settings before dispatch
body.summary: Add the shared local app-server handshake and open or resume a session without a prompt. Resolve the catalog alias and effort, apply session-only settings and verify runtime read-back. Release a failed preflight process and preserve the headless default path.
acceptanceChecks: Unsupported or mismatched selections stop before a prompt is sent
New and resumed sessions confirm the effective model and effort
Cancellation or error during setup releases the local child

tests.name: Scripted Vibe handshake, new and resumed preflight, unsupported aliases and settings read-back
